finding.title: Guard ProfileRepositoryImpl.deleteProfile's cloud-sync push the same way create/update/ensureDefaultProfile do
finding.why: createProfile, updateProfile, and ensureDefaultProfile all wrap their `_syncEngine?.push*` call in try/catch with an explicit 'offline-first, cloud push is non-fatal' comment. deleteProfile does not: `await _syncEngine?.deleteLearnerProfile(id)` runs bare, after the local cascade-delete transaction has already committed across ~12 tables. Both push and delete enqueue through the same outbox `_enqueue` mechanism (a local Drift insert), so they carry the same theoretical failure mode (e.g. disk-full, DB-locked). If that insert throws, the whole deleteProfile Future rejects even though the profile is already gone locally — and neither of deleteProfile's two callers in this batch (profile_edit_delete_actions.dart's deleteProfileFlow, profile_picker_screen.dart's _showDeleteDialog) catch it either, so the exception surfaces as an unhandled error in a button's onPressed handler while the delete has, in fact, already succeeded — contradicting the offline-first invariant this same file documents for every other mutation.
finding.recommendation: Wrap `await _syncEngine?.deleteLearnerProfile(id)` in the same non-fatal try/catch (with logging per the previous finding) used by createProfile/updateProfile/ensureDefaultProfile.
acceptance_criteria: deleteProfile's sync call is wrapped in try/catch matching its siblings, with a logged, non-fatal failure
A test with a SyncWriteFacade fake that throws on deleteLearnerProfile asserts ProfileRepositoryImpl.deleteProfile still completes normally

finding.title: Add a Locale('he') behavioral variant to StatCard's interactive widget tests (epic_26_story_26_16)
finding.why: StatCard is a core/widgets/ primitive explicitly built for a bilingual RTL app (its own AC6 wants 'golden tests in 3 visual variants, en + he each'), but all 5 interactive testWidgets (text rendering, tap handling) hardcode Locale('en'); only the 3 golden-smoke tests touch 'he', and those skip the actual matchesGoldenFile compare via skipGolden: true. A regression that breaks hit-testing or layout specifically under RTL mirroring (e.g. the tap target shifting when Directionality flips) would not be caught anywhere in this file.
finding.recommendation: Parameterize the 5 testWidgets over both locales, or add an 'he' counterpart for at least the tap-behavior test.
acceptance_criteria: at least one StatCard testWidgets test in this file pumps with Locale('he') and asserts tap/render behavior, not just a skipped golden compare

finding.title: Replace track_dao.dart's stringly-typed TrackState class with a real Dart enum
finding.why: TrackState is a 4-value closed lifecycle (active/retired/archived/deleted) central to this HOTSPOT file's whole model, modeled as bare String constants on a TextColumn with no DB-level or compiler-level check that only these 4 values ever get stored. Any code that branches on `.state` gets no exhaustiveness checking, and nothing stops a typo'd string reaching the column (mitigated today only by everyone remembering to use the TrackState.* constants rather than literals — a convention, not a guarantee).
finding.recommendation: Model TrackState as a real Dart `enum` (or use Drift's `.withConverter` to store it as text but expose an enum in Dart), so switches over track state are compiler-exhaustive and no non-member string can be constructed.
acceptance_criteria: TrackState is a Dart enum (or enum-backed column); all TrackState.active-style call sites in this batch keep compiling.
Any switch/when over the state value is exhaustive without a default/_ arm.

finding.title: Extract scheduler_providers.dart's private _amnestyDayCutoffUtc/anchor-clamp so reorder_amnesty_test.dart calls it instead of hand-copying it
finding.why: _amnestyDayCutoffUtc is a private top-level function, so no test file can import and call it; the 3 'projection amnesty' tests in Scenario A (basic cutoff, mid-day cutoff, program back-date anchor-clamp) each hand-retype the algorithm instead (one comment even says 'Mimic the production day-level cutoff'). If a future edit to the real function or the isAfter(anchor) clamp regresses, these 3 tests stay green because they only check their own copy. Partial mitigation: scheduler_providers_branches_test.dart's RA1/RA2 do drive the real allDailyTasksProvider for the non-program path, but the program-specific back-date anchor-clamp scenario here has no confirmed real-path coverage elsewhere.
finding.recommendation: Mark _amnestyDayCutoffUtc @visibleForTesting (or move it plus the clamp expression to a small pure function in domain/projection/) and have reorder_amnesty_test.dart's three amnesty tests call it directly instead of retyping the algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: reorder_amnesty_test.dart imports and calls the real cutoff/clamp function; no inline DateTime.utc(local.year, local.month, local.day) reimplementation remains in the test file.
A mutation flipping isAfter to isBefore in the anchor clamp (scheduler_providers.dart:683) fails this test file.

finding.title: Rewrite track_dual_progress_reactivity_test.dart so it stops overriding the provider it claims to guard
finding.why: Both tests replace trackDualProgressMetricsProvider's own body with a stub that independently calls ref.watch<int>(completionCommittedProvider) itself (lines 27, 69). A Riverpod .overrideWith fully replaces the provider's create function, so the real body in lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart:357 is never invoked by either test. Deleting that real ref.watch<int>(completionCommittedProvider) line today — silently breaking the dashboard/progress-hub's live refresh after a completion — would not fail either test in this file, despite the file's own docstring calling itself 'Regression test for Fix 3'. Contrast with the correctly-built sibling recent_activity_reactivity_test.dart, which drives the real production provider body over a real in-memory DB with no override of the provider under test.
finding.recommendation: Rewrite using the recent_activity_reactivity_test.dart pattern: real in-memory DB, unmodified trackDualProgressMetricsProvider, seed a completion, tick completionCommittedProvider, assert the provider's actual output changes.
acceptance_criteria: Test constructs trackDualProgressMetricsProvider without overriding that same provider family
Test goes red when ref.watch<int>(completionCommittedProvider) is deleted from lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart:357
